for_each: select id,code from reviews order by code
name: review-protocol
title: Review protocol record

sections.title: Search register
sections.sql: select name,query,searched_on,records_found,evidence_ref from searches where review_id=$1 order by code

for_each: select id,code from reviews order by code
name: exclusion-log
title: Report exclusion log

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.sql: select code,name,status,exclusion_reason from record_status where review_id=$1 and status in ('abstract_excluded','fulltext_excluded') order by code

sections.title: Decision evidence
sections.sql: select r.code,v.stage,v.reviewer,v.decision,v.reason from votes v join records r on r.id=v.record_id where r.review_id=$1 order by r.code,v.stage,v.reviewer

for_each: select id,code from reviews order by code
name: evidence-pack
title: Draft review evidence pack

sections.title: Included reports
sections.sql: select code,name,study_key,fulltext_ref from record_status where review_id=$1 and status='included' order by code

sections.title: Extracted values
sections.sql: select r.code,e.field,e.value,e.source_ref,e.extractor,e.checked_by,e.checked_on from extractions e join record_status r on r.id=e.record_id where r.review_id=$1 and r.status='included' order by r.code,e.field

sections.title: Appraisals
sections.sql: select r.code,a.tool,a.judgement,a.rationale,a.source_ref,a.reviewer from appraisals a join record_status r on r.id=a.record_id where r.review_id=$1 and r.status='included' order by r.code

sections.title: Open checks
sections.sql: select reference,rule,source,detail from compliance_findings where review_id=$1 order by rule,reference
sections.note: Internal draft. Reporting support only. Human methodological review remains required.
